[color=#ea9999]Installation Guide - Please Read![/color][/b][/size]

1. Download and install the Passerby Cemetery mod here: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22600

2. Download and extract my mod into your mod folder, you'll be asked to replace 4 images, press yes.

3. Pat yourself on the back, you did it! :)

v.0.3
Sorry for the wait, but it's done! My original plan of making this into a Content Patcher mod sort of... failed. I think the way the original mod is coded makes it incompatible with edits, that or I just suck at coding lol. Anyways, the installation method is still manual, sorry about that!


v.0.2
The Nikolai mod has been merged into the Passerby Cemetery mod, and so has Boxy. There's also been a few changes, mainly Boxy no longer has a rain overworld or portrait sprite, which is what the first version of my mod added a raincoat to. I've improvised and added the raincoat to the portraits for fall and winter.
